summary.text: Andrew Parrott, a Libertarian Party candidate who also ran in the same seat's April 2025 special election, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 6th Congressional District to Randy Fine.
In a 2025 interview he said he worked about 20 years for one employer and had left the Republican Party for the Libertarian Party.

paragraphs.text: In a February 2025 AskFlagler interview, Parrott said he worked for roughly twenty years at a company whose health plan was self-insured and administered by Blue Cross Blue Shield. He said he joined the Libertarian Party after having been "more closely associated with the Republicans for most of my life."
WKMG ClickOrlando's 2026 voter's guide lists his age as 54.
Parrott ran as the Libertarian candidate in the April 1, 2025, special election and received 702 votes (0.4%). He was the Libertarian nominee in 2026.
He received 1.1% of the vote to Randy Fine's 58.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
